Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands sales segment 
Please drop 1-2 bullets: why we won or lost recent deals, and one concrete ask for leadership. Keep each reply short.

Rina: Win: demoed consistent p99 and a clear cost model; buyer cited predictable billing as the tie-breaker. Ask: publish a short "cost story" blurb SEs can use.

Tom: Loss: a prospect wanted built-in signal routing + vendor plugin marketplace. Ask: product decide whether to add plugin hooks or document integrations.

Kira: Win: Console traces + per-route cost visibility convinced an infra lead to proceed. Loss: they still wanted managed KMS. Ask: an ETA or workaround we can give customers.

Omar: SE note: on-prem install complexity lost a mid-market deal. Ask: a scripted quickstart and a simple checklist for customers.

Rina: Also customers loved the KV caching demo (saw ~30% token drop). Ask: update the caching examples repo with a short runnable demo.

Sam: OK I will collect these and create a triage card. Reply +1 to confirm or add one short quote we can use in PRDs.

Kira: +1 
Quote: "Console traces made debugging painless"

ops-bot: Reminder: please complete the all-hands survey (2 mins).

Sam: Thanks all 
I will ping owners tomorrow and add these asks to the roadmap triage.
